purpose: Teach: 総体/元祖/置き場/アウトソーシング/空調/積立/延べ/一様

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、業界総体を見据えてらした
lines.en: When your father was founding the company, he kept the whole industry in view.
lines.style: Quiet, steady admiration. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. Long, patient pauses between thoughts. The voice of someone remembering something true and important.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが当業界の元祖と呼ばれた
lines.en: Yes. My father came to be called the founder of our industry.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Small nod in the voice on 'founder.' Not boasting — stating fact with quiet conviction. Respectful to the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品の置き場まで自ら確認された
lines.en: Your father even checked the product storage himself.
lines.style: Gentle marvel underneath. Slight lift on 'himself' — emphasizing the personal care. Warm, almost wondering tone. Like he's still impressed by the attention to detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはアウトソーシングを早期に導入された
lines.en: Yes. He adopted outsourcing early on.
lines.style: Calm reflection. Not looking back with regret, but with understanding of foresight. Slight breathiness on the opening. Acknowledging a legacy choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員のために空調を整えられた
lines.en: Your father even arranged the air conditioning for the staff.
lines.style: Voice soft with feeling. A small, knowing smile in the tone — this is a small detail that means something large. Tender pause on 'for the staff.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが退職積立制度を導入された
lines.en: Yes. He established a retirement savings plan for all the employees.
lines.style: Steady, reflective. Even tone that respects both the choice and the work it took. Not self-congratulatory. Simply holding the fact of foresight and care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業以来の延べ顧客数に感慨深かった
lines.en: Your father felt deeply moved by how many customers we've served since the founding.
lines.style: Voice thickens slightly with emotion. Long, measured delivery. The weight of cumulative meaning — all those people, all those years. Trailing off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に一様な機会を与えられた
lines.en: Yes. He gave all employees equal opportunity.
lines.style: Final statement, clear and firm but not hard. This is the closing note — the principle that tied everything together. Breath settles. A quiet period at the end of a longer thought.
